svg.title: Fête à Torcy
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after inspecting a public publisher PDF plate. Approximate contour and vivid palette. Two blue/yellow rectangular panel sections separated by a dark wooden strip. Overall dimensions from caption; subtle paint texture omitted.
